official.status_note: The official Utrecht University page states: 'Due to significant budget cuts, the Utrecht Excellence Scholarship (UES) will no longer be offered for programmes starting in the 2026-2027 academic year. No new UES applications will be accepted as of the upcoming admissions cycle.' Existing award holders keep their funding 'unchanged and will continue as agreed'.
benefits: Published on uu.nl for current holders: 'If you have already been awarded a UES, your scholarship remains unchanged and will continue as agreed.'
official.application_route: No application route exists for new applicants; Utrecht University states no new UES applications will be accepted from the upcoming admissions cycle (programmes starting 2026-2027) onwards.
official.description: Utrecht University's own pages state that due to significant budget cuts the Utrecht Excellence Scholarship (UES) will no longer be offered for programmes starting in the 2026-2027 academic year, that no new UES applications will be accepted as of the upcoming admissions cycle, and that scholarships already awarded continue unchanged as agreed.

verification.notes: Checked the official uu.nl UES pages (masters and bachelors versions) and UU's current Masters scholarships-and-grants overview on 2026-10-10; the URL given in the assignment (uu.nl/.../utrecht-university-excellence-scholarships) now returns 404, and the programme's current official page is a discontinuation notice only, so no amounts, coverage or terms are published.

applicant_utility.summary: Do not plan around this scholarship: Utrecht University's official page states the Utrecht Excellence Scholarship was ended from the 2026-2027 intake onwards because of budget cuts, and no new applications are being accepted, so there is no live amount, deadline or application route to quote. Students who already hold a UES keep their funding unchanged, but a fresh applicant gains nothing by waiting. UU's current Masters scholarships page instead points to surviving routes such as the Bright Minds Fellowships (EU/EEA students, around 10 awards of EUR 5,000 or EUR 10,000, applied for separately after submitting the master's application) and the NL Scholarship, plus smaller faculty funds. Verify everything on uu.nl rather than on aggregator listings, which still advertise the discontinued UES.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Only relevant to applicants who already hold a UES award; prospective students should target the alternative scholarships UU still lists.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm on uu.nl/masters/utrecht-excellence-scholarships that the discontinuation notice still applies before relying on any UES figure from a third-party site.

If you hold an EU/EEA passport, prepare the separate Bright Minds Fellowship application in Osiris Online Application (link on the Bright Minds page) after submitting your master's application; it opens 1 November and closes 1 February 23:59 CET.
If you are a non-EU/EEA master's applicant, review the NL Scholarship page UU publishes and any faculty-level funds on UU's Scholarships and grants page.
For enrolment confirmations needed by external scholarship bodies, email scholarship@uu.nl as UU's page instructs.
common_rejection_risks: Budgeting or deferring admission based on an aggregator's outdated UES amount or 1 February deadline that no longer exists at UU.
Assuming the Bright Minds Fellowship is automatic with the master's application; it requires a separate Osiris application with its own 1 February 23:59 CET cut-off.
Missing the published warning that applications submitted between 27 January and 1 February cannot be corrected or supplemented if information is incomplete.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Full non-EU/EEA master's tuition fees plus living costs in Utrecht, since no UU excellence funding is available for new students from the 2026-2027 intake; exact fee figures must come from UU's Tuition Fees page for the specific programme.
document_audit: No UES application or document list exists any more; do not assemble documents from old UES brochures or listicles.

For the Bright Minds route, have the requested document ready for upload in Osiris alongside the fellowship questions, and double-check grades and activity evidence because the committee weighs academic achievement, background and interpersonal skills.
alerts: Utrecht University states the UES ended due to significant budget cuts and no new UES applications are accepted for the 2026-2027 academic year onwards.

The scholarship URL recorded in most catalogues (uu.nl/en/organisation/scholarships-and-grants/utrecht-university-excellence-scholarships) is now a dead 404; the live programme page is uu.nl/en/masters/utrecht-excellence-scholarships.
Existing UES awards are unaffected and continue as agreed, so only new applicants are impacted.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: There is no submission path for the UES itself; new applicants must apply to the master's programme through Studielink/Osiris and then use any separate UU scholarship route (for example the Bright Minds Fellowship form in Osiris) linked from UU's Scholarships and grants page.
